notes: Overview: EditorPilot builds a VS Code extension copilot aimed at SMBs and internal developer teams. Focus: low-latency streaming completions, inline suggestions, adaptive model pinning per workspace.
Primary ask: sub-150ms p95 for inline completions; streaming token latency <20ms for perceived instantaneous typing. p50 target ~10ms on local edge nodes.
Traffic profile: 1.5k concurrent active developers in peak, average request length 30-120 tokens, bursts to 4k during demos/hackathons.
Cost sensitivity: high — tight margins. Want Optimize recommendations for batching + caching to reduce per-token spend. Interested in per-route cost dashboards.

Model preferences: prefer open-chat-style models with ability to pin versions per workspace/customer. Need ability to route premium enterprise orgs to non-quantized variants and fall back to quantized 7B when capacity constrained.

Auth & rate limits: extension uses JWTs minted by EditorPilot backend; need clarity on per-user rate limits, token bucket behaviors, and token refresh interactions while offline. Also want per-developer quotas and org-wide burst allowances.
Security: SOC2/ISO alignment mandatory for enterprise customers. Require SSO (SAML), audit logs for prompts & responses, KMS integration for secrets, and EU data residency for some customers.

Integration notes: VS Code marketplace distribution + in-extension telemetry. Will use Redwood streaming API for real-time completions and fall back to local quantized model via optional on-device binary for offline devs.
POC scope: 2-week POC: run streaming latency test with simulated keystroke load (1.5k concurrency), measure p95/p99, validate model pinning rules and graceful fallback behavior.
